errors.tooLong: Choose a password of at most {max} characters.
errors.tooManyAttempts: Too many attempts. Wait a minute, then try again.
errors.failed: Setting your password did not work. Try again.

patientProfile.title: Patient

editPatient.phoneImpossible: The phone number does not look right. Check its digits; a number from another country starts with + and its country code.
editPatient.visitsAhead: This patient has a visit ahead, so they cannot be archived or marked deceased yet.
editPatient.notFound: This patient could not be found. Go back to the patient list.

ahead.heading: Visits ahead:
ahead.cancelFirst: Cancel or move these visits first, then change the status.

calendar.noProviders: No providers yet. Each provider gets a column here.
calendar.readFailed: This day could not be read again, so it may be out of date. It is tried again the next time you use the page.
calendar.clinicChanged: The clinic was changed in another tab. Reload the page to go on in the clinic chosen there.

booking.title: New appointment
booking.noTreatments: No treatments yet. Each treatment the clinic offers gets a button here.
booking.overlap: This time overlaps another visit of this provider. Choose another time, or another provider.
booking.alreadyBooked: This patient is already booked with this provider at this time, so it was not booked again.
booking.patientNotBookable: This patient cannot be booked: only an active patient can. Choose the patient again.
booking.providerNotBookable: This provider takes no new appointments. Choose another provider.
booking.treatmentNotBookable: This treatment is no longer offered. Choose another treatment.
booking.startSkipped: The clocks skip this start on this day. Choose another time.
booking.unreachable: No phone and no email: no reminder can reach this patient. Book still books the visit.
booking.phoneImpossible: The phone number does not look right. Check its digits; a number from another country starts with + and its country code.
booking.newPatientForbidden: Your role cannot add patients. Choose a patient who is already in the list.

warning.anyway: You can still book it with Book anyway.
warning.closedDay: The clinic is closed that day: {label}.
warning.noHours: The clinic is closed that day: no opening hours on {weekday}.

appointment.nothingToChange: Nothing to change on this visit.

undo_completion.label: Undo done
undo_completion.done: Done undone: back in the chair.

cancelDialog.title: Cancel this visit
cancelDialog.description: Who cancelled is kept with the visit.

refusals.notAllowed: This visit was changed meanwhile. Look at it again.
refusals.tooEarly: A no-show can be marked once the visit has started.
refusals.notFound: This visit is no longer there.

clinic.name: Clinic name
clinic.timeZoneHint: Every date and time in Chairside is shown in this time zone.
clinic.countryHint: A phone number written without + and its country code is read as a number of this country.
clinic.timeZoneUnknown: Chairside cannot use this time zone. Choose another time zone from the list.

hours.intro: Switch on each weekday the clinic opens, and choose when it opens and closes: the closing time comes after the opening time. The calendar shades the hours the clinic is closed.

closedDays.heading: Closed days
closedDays.intro: Days the clinic stays closed although its opening hours say open, such as public holidays. The calendar shows each one as closed, with its label.
closedDays.label: Label
closedDays.alreadyClosed: The clinic is already closed on this date. Choose another date.
closedDays.inThePast: This date has passed. Choose today or a later date.
closedDays.notClosed: This day is no longer closed: it was removed meanwhile, in another tab or by someone else. Reload the page to see the closed days as they are now.
closedDays.removePast: This day has passed, so it stays as it is. Reload the page to see the closed days from today on.

treatmentTypes.heading: Treatment types
treatmentTypes.intro: What the booking drawer offers, each with the length a booking starts with. A type made inactive is offered no more; the visits booked with it stay as they are.
treatmentTypes.none: No treatment types yet. Add the first one below: until then nothing can be booked.
treatmentTypes.name: Name
treatmentTypes.nameTaken: An active treatment type already has this name. Choose another name, or make the other one inactive first.
treatmentTypes.priceDecimals: Prices in {currency} have no decimals. Write the price as a whole number.
treatmentTypes.priceTooHigh: This price is too high. Check the price.
treatmentTypes.notFound: This treatment type is no longer there. Reload the page to see the treatment types as they are now.
treatmentTypes.alreadyInactive: This treatment type is already inactive: it was changed meanwhile, in another tab or by someone else. Reload the page to see it as it is now.
treatmentTypes.alreadyActive: This treatment type is already active: it was changed meanwhile, in another tab or by someone else. Reload the page to see it as it is now.
treatmentTypes.activeNameTaken: An active treatment type has this name. Make that one inactive first, or rename this one.

providers.heading: Providers
providers.intro: Each provider is a column on the calendar, in this order, and a choice in the booking drawer.
providers.none: No providers yet. Add the first one below: until then nothing can be booked.
providers.name: Name
providers.kindLocked: A login is linked to this provider, so the kind stays as it is: what the login may do follows it.
providers.deactivatedWithVisits: Provider made inactive. {count, plural, one {# visit ahead stays booked with them.} other {# visits ahead stay booked with them.}}
providers.breaksIntro: A break repeats every week on its weekday. The calendar hatches it, and the booking drawer warns when a visit runs into it. Two breaks of one provider cannot overlap.
providers.breaksNone: No breaks yet. Add the first one below.
providers.breakOverlaps: This break overlaps another break of this provider on that weekday. Change its times, or remove the other break first.
providers.breakNotFound: This break is no longer there: it was removed meanwhile, in another tab or by someone else. Close this window and reload the page to see the breaks as they are now.
providers.alreadyFirst: This provider is already first: the order was changed meanwhile, in another tab or by someone else. Reload the page to see it as it is now.
providers.alreadyLast: This provider is already last: the order was changed meanwhile, in another tab or by someone else. Reload the page to see it as it is now.
providers.providerLinked: A login is linked to this provider, so its kind cannot be changed. Keep the kind as it was.
providers.notFound: This provider is no longer there. Reload the page to see the providers as they are now.
providers.alreadyInactive: This provider is already inactive: it was changed meanwhile, in another tab or by someone else. Reload the page to see it as it is now.
providers.alreadyActive: This provider is already active: it was changed meanwhile, in another tab or by someone else. Reload the page to see it as it is now.

tabs.firstContent: Type in the field, choose another tab, then come back: the field is empty again. A tab's content leaves the page when another tab is chosen, so a form never spans two tabs.
tabs.secondContent: The second tab's content. The arrow keys move between the tabs.

drawer.heading: Drawer
drawer.title: A drawer
drawer.description: 420 px wide, as the booking and appointment drawers.
drawer.descriptionWide: 500 px wide, as the aftercare review.

drawer.body: Escape, the close button or a click on the overlay closes it, and the focus goes back to the button that opened it.

dialog.description: A question with a few fields, over the drawer's overlay.
dialog.field: A field: the first focus lands here

nested.heading: A dialog inside a form
nested.intro: The outer form holds the dialog, and the dialog holds a form. Pressing the inner form's button sends the inner form only: the outer form's answer, a refusal, never shows.
nested.title: The inner form
nested.outerRefused: The outer form was sent as well.

form.heading: The form pattern
form.intro: Send it to see each answer. A short or long note, a code that is not four digits, empty or long details, or no choice shows an error at its field. The checkbox and the switch send “on” when they show on, and nothing when they show off. Sent from a tab whose clinic another tab has changed, it asks for a reload.
form.refused: The demo action said no, as it was asked to.
